title: The Mnemonic Course
summary: A course in tying drilled responses to simple cues so an ally or the self answers a signal with the whole trained form.

title: A Treatise on Held Recollection
summary: A treatise on holding every observed detail of a fight and using it to clear a clouded mind and to counter a repeated move.

title: The Reverie Handbook
summary: A handbook on the drifting half-waking state in which memory runs freely and on calling a dazed ally out of it or snaring a foe in it.

title: Manual of Faithful Memory
summary: A manual of memory kept faithful against all drift that records a scene entire and wards the mind against tampering.

title: The Palimpsest Compendium
summary: A compendium on the many layers a memory carries and how to scrape one layer clean to expose another or write a new layer over it.
